description:
Join Our Team at Fuerda Smartech!


Are you ready to drive innovation in the automotive industry? Fuerda Smartech, a technology powerhouse with over 497 national patents, is on the hunt for a Production Planner and Customer Support Specialist💻 to be part of our dynamic team.

At Fuerda Smartech, we're at the forefront of automotive technology. We specialize in designing, developing, and manufacturing mid-to-high-end automotive intelligent electronic integrated control systems, cutting-edge lighting solutions, production of air-vents, and other basic components for vehicles.

Requirements:

✅ Min. 3 years experience in Production Planner;

✅ B2 English level;

✅ Knowledge of using ERP software (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics) and Excel (intermediate level – pivots / graphs / usual formulas);

✅ General knowledge of manufacturing preparation (BOM / Routing / Production version etc.)

✅ Experience in using customer portals from the automotive industry (nice to have);

✅ Team player, ability to plan and prioritize, attention to detail, strong organizational, analytical skills.

 

Benefits: 

🍔 Meal vouchers;

🍽️ Meal discounts for catering;

🏥 Private Healthcare at Medlife (business package); Private Medical Services (Medlife – business package);

🐰 Christmas and Easter bonuses;

🌟 Bonuses based on KPI`s;

🎁 13th salary;

🌴 25 days of annually vacation;

🚌 Transport on predetermined routes.

 

Responsabilities:

✅ According to all tasks directly involved in the preparation of production, taking into account the order situation, production capacities, stock levels, production arrears, delivery arrears and procurement situations, to create the conditions of an optimal production sequence.

✅Providing the necessary production documentation and data for each production order, in order to guarantee efficient and high quality work handling.

✅Ensuring the bringing of materials, assistance and operational resources, to ensure that the material requirements for starting the order are met at the optimal time.

✅Detailed production sequence control to achieve optimal use of resources.

✅Insure the correctness of the records in the SAP / MES / WMS information systems etc and update the data in systems . coincide with the physical situation in the field [received / lack of inventory, etc.] ;

✅Maintains the relationship with the clients and, as the case may be, check the EDI interfaces to monitor the status of the orders/needs of the client;

✅Monitor the delivery situation and inform customers about their situation;

✅Introduces specific reports regarding the production performed /deliveries / mp inputs / components, etc

✅ Managing customer relationships through orders, tracking, and delivery according to their needs (quantity/delivery terms).

✅ Enters daily orders (EDI / mail / periodic meetings) from the client;

✅Responsible for evaluating the performance achieved by the client (customer satisfaction);

✅Updates the information in the specific client portals;

✅Actively contributes to the cooperation with all other stakeholders and interface partners and the transmission of all relevant information, to keep themselves and others informed and to create an optimal logistics chain.

✅Ensuring the training of new employees on topics defined together with the Department Manager.


Your expertise will drive us forward! We`re excting to meet you!
